layers.layer: Other Effective Area-based Conservation Measures/Autres mesures de conservation efficaces par zone

notice: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada.
caveat: Emergency and in-season closures are not in these files: they close a fishery for a time by notice (the Federal Register, a regional office's bulletin), not by a new boundary. A management area's GIS is not its legal definition; the regulation's text is.
